title: Phase 1 — trusted authorization + read-only operational status foundation for PAIR Chat (Independent Audit R1 correction)
description: R1 CORRECTION on BASE 5b5ab73 (audited HEAD 4c2118d; findings F1-F4). F1: scoped auth is default-deny — caller-claim-minted `operator` principals are UNVERIFIED (scoped sections report UNVERIFIED_IDENTITY); only admin (global) and telegram (ingress-verified own provenance) receive data. x-operator-id, session-owner claims, objective ownership and BUSINESS_CREATED chains are provenance inputs, never authority — forged-victim-id regression included. F2: PAIR_MC_ADMIN_TOKEN is bearer-only (never ?token=) and authenticates ONLY conversation create/read/turns; all other /api routes require the MC token (credentials/missions/budgets/config/drafts/confirms → 401). MC-token behavior unchanged. F3: ConversationTurnInput.read_only + status-intent check inside turn() structurally suppress proposal persistence before draft minting — proven over real HTTP with a PAIR_PROPOSAL-emitting model (zero drafts); normal proposal/confirm flows preserved. F4: resolveMcAdminToken requires explicit config, >=16 chars, entropy and non-static value; secret never logged/persisted. Bounded STATUS envelope semantics unchanged: bilingual intents, held/committed/settled distinct, integrity[] codes, valid-JSON ENVELOPE_EXCEEDS_BOUND degradation; hook runs only after replay + stale gates. New pair-phase1-http-boundary.test.ts proves F1-F3 over real HTTP.
